newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pathe gains on first-half results.
newsitem.headline: Pathe gains on first-half results.

text.p: Shares in French media group Pathe rose on Wednesday on the back of better-than-expected first half results, analysts said.
Pathe holds the media interests of the former Chargeurs holding group, which split into Pathe and Chargeurs International earlier this year.
Analysts said they had raised their 1996 forecasts on the basis of the first-half figures, which were considered particularly good for the film production and distribution business.
The stock was up 43 francs at 1,372 at 1450 GMT.
Pathe on Tuesday posted first-half profit of 132 million francs, up from a proforma profit of 40 million a year ago.
One analyst said the stock was tradng at a 36 percent discount and had significant room for appreciation.
